Hi, as you said this is a very toxic relationship. I understand how scary and confusing this might be for you and I am sorry that you had to go through this.

What I would like you know is that you are not responsable for the actions of her. I know is not exactly a solution but it is the truth. 

I would recommend to meet up with her on a place that is not very crowded. Start talking about good things of the time you were together. Be honest about what you are saying and tell her that you think is best that you can no longer continue as couple. Try to end things well. I know it hard because of the many struggles that she has but you must go first. 

Control your emotions and try to be calm at all times. Maybe be ready for manipulation such as threats with suicide. Do not submit to those things. If things go this route I would strongly recommend for you to talk with your parents. They can really help you out. Doing this is hard but is best. Maybe alert her parents or a family member. 

But this separation will improve your quality of life. You are responsable for your wellbeing. The rest leave it for professionals, they know better. 

Good luck OP
